selection: Equal source/window mean of eligible state V NLL + recovery BCE + conditional step NLL; earliest minimum including initialization
initialization: random; no pretrained state model or P0 input
seed_policy: seed is for development preflight; evaluation_seeds specifies paired formal runs
data_policy: P1 only; IH shares READY group splits; REBOOT episode splits; InterruptBench V only; do not mix response references with state labels
test_policy: Previously exposed tests; all requested dev selections precede test scoring; no test tuning
batch_policy: Fixed seed0 tie-shuffled event-length-sorted row grouping shared across all variants and seeds, batch16; precompile once per variant; seed-specific epoch minibatch order paired across variants and independent of initialization RNG; dev/test length-sorted only for padding efficiency

ablations.A1: remove person access and comprehension gating; deliberate information-boundary violation
ablations.A2: conditional-independent BCQ posterior at each filter layer
ablations.A3: retain only most recent five person events in filter and encoding
ablations.A4: remove temporally causal next-person-action/step emission consistency loss
ablations.A5: remove conditional-step training auxiliary loss; same step evaluation and dev selection
ablations.A6: label-independent fixed transition gate probabilities; prediction heads remain trainable

metrics.aggregation: per source/native-window; paired seed0-19 mean and sample SD; no pooled source claim

checkpoint_policy: Write only the predeclared final A0 seed0 representative immediately after its complete 40-epoch training and dev selection; hold all other final candidates in memory; full report and test scoring only after all 140 selections; no epoch checkpoints
output_policy: Refuse existing output directory; --output NEW_EMPTY_DIRECTORY supports from-scratch reproduction without replacing formal results
